digest.component_or_area: Jira family sanitizers and label validation
propositions: Cloud and DC both accept 255-character labels and reject 256-character labels, measured on live instances; the reported divergence (DC 254 vs Cloud 255) does not exist.
The shared JIRA_LABEL_MAX_CHARS constant is correct at 255 for both deployments; per-deployment configuration is unnecessary.

sanitize_label raises InvalidLabelError above the ceiling (does not truncate), while sanitize_summary truncates with a visible suffix; this divergence is intentional and documented because labels are identity tokens.
Four characterization oracle tests pass after measurement confirmed the premise was false; no code changes to the sanitizer were needed.
